title: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT from a substitution variable — gate not verifiable statically
expected_feedback: Hygiene: the parameter is set from a SQL*Plus substitution variable, so its value cannot be read from the script. This is recorded as satisfying the gate because it cannot be proven wrong — not because it was verified, and the distinction belongs in Uncovered Risks rather than being silently rounded up to compliant. Confirm what &deploy_lock_timeout resolves to in the deploy pipeline: 0 would mean NOWAIT and no protection at all, and a value near the 1000000 ceiling would outlive the maintenance window. A literal is preferable in a migration script precisely because it is reviewable.
violated_rule: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT set before every DDL session
